lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct horizontal and vertical alignments posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form a visible grid-like pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper flank characterized by a sharp luminance gradient, transitioning from high intensity on top to shadow below.
